title: The backlog configuration of a repository
description: The file .backlog/config.json at the root of a repository, committed in each branch.

backlog_repository.description: Path of the folder that holds the items, relative to the repository; ".backlog" when the items live inside the repository.

backlog_origin_url.description: Address from which backlog setup clones a separate backlog repository.

user.description: The person who uses the user commands, written by backlog setup.

team.description: The team a team command acts for when neither the flag nor the variable names one.

teams_file_sha.description: The SHA of the team file as last validated.

item_definition.description: Path of the item definition that items without a team use in this repository and branch; absent means the definition packaged with the CLI.

archive_folder.description: Folder, beside the open items, that backlog archive moves an item into.

repository_variable.description: Name of the environment variable that gives the repository.

branch_variable.description: Name of the environment variable that gives the branch.

team_variable.description: Name of the environment variable that gives the team.

agent_variable.description: Name of the environment variable that gives the agent.

session_variable.description: Name of the environment variable that gives the session.

migrated_at.description: When the items of this repository were converted to JSON.

migrated_by_version.description: The version of the CLI that converted them.

redact_pii.description: true applies the redaction rules marked when-enabled (redaction-spec.md).

push-backlog-updates.description: false stops the push of the commits the CLI makes; true by default (decision 76).

redaction_rules.description: The repository's own redaction rules, in the form of redaction.schema.json, applied beside the packaged default ones.
